title: Back-of-Envelope
html:
The ability to quickly estimate scale requirements. Interviewers use this to see if you understand the magnitude of the problem before designing.

Key Numbers to Memorize

1M
seconds in 12 days
86K
seconds in a day
8KB
average tweet storage
1PB
= 1,000 TB = 1M GB

Twitter Estimation Example

Monthly Active Users300M
Daily Active Users (30%)90M
Tweets per user per day2
Tweets per day180M
Tweets per second (QPS)~2,100
Tweet size (text + metadata)~1 KB
Storage per day180 GB
Storage per year~65 TB

Estimation Framework

Steps

1. Users: MAU → DAU (usually 10-30% of MAU)
2. Actions: How many per user per day?
3. QPS: Total actions ÷ 86,400 seconds
4. Peak QPS: 2-3× average QPS
5. Storage: Size of one unit × count per day × retention period
6. Bandwidth: Avg request size × QPS
